page.layout: One page of text inside an ornamental woodcut border; no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top left, then text in one column, from top to bottom.

main_text.p: sum brevissimeq; esse complexũ videmus. Inspiciantur quæ de hoc præparationum genere non modò tradit Guido de Monte (est enim prolixis circulationibus tædiosi- or) sed etiam quæ longè experien- tissimus vir Isaacus Hollandus de salibus & oleis metallorum peculi- liari Tractatu proposuit (quan- quam furnũ Reverberii clausum, perpaucis illum cognitum, quo u- sus est Paracelsus, cum monticulo intus defiderant, alias præparari nequeunt) cætera per se apertasunt præsertim si cum tractatu de oleo vitrioli, Itemq; Antimonii & Mer- curii (de quibus supra) conjungan- tur.
Nec verò prætermittere possũ hoc loco, quin ad clarissima illa Paracelsi & Bartholomæi Korn- dor-

page.notes: The first line of the page reads "sum brevissimeq;" with the sentence running from the previous page. Page header is "72 CHEIARGOGIA". The text ends with a hyphenated word "Korn-dor-" continuing on the next page. Print is faint in places; the words "conjungan-tur" and "dor-" are read with some uncertainty.
